title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Binance has spent half its SAFU bitcoin, about $580 million worth, data shows
description: The user protection fund now sits below the $800 million level that Binance’s own rules say triggers a top-up, and the exchange hasn’t said when it will refill it.

title: Arbitrum’s council moved $30 million of Binance hack funds without the hacker’s key
description: A 12-person committee briefly rewrote one of Arbitrum’s core contracts to spend from an address it held no key for, then put the code back. It’s the second time this year.

title: Crypto.com to withdraw Hong Kong consumer app citing regulatory changes
description: Crypto.com will discontinue its consumer app services in Hong Kong in February next year.

title: Bitcoin drops below $77,000 as chip rout deepens ahead of U.S. midterm vote
description: ZEC tumbled nearly 10% and BNB fell under $700 as the Nasdaq 100 slid into a correction, dragging Asian stocks lower.

title: Australia lifts rates to 18-year high as AI boom, energy costs fuel inflation
description: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its benchmark rate to 4.85% on rising technology costs from AI investment and higher energy prices.

title: UK warns AI ransomware attack on infrastructure ‘highly likely’ by 2028
description: The warning comes as UK cyber officials also flag growing threats from state-backed hackers targeting government officials and politicians.

title: Binance begins second withdrawal phase, exchange outflows slow
description: The exchange says additional assets will become available for withdrawal from 04:00 UTC on Tuesday as security checks are completed, following an initial reopening on Sunday.

title: South Korea urges exchanges to boost cold storage after Binance hack
description: South Korean crypto exchanges are already required to hold at least 80% of customer crypto in cold wallets, but the regulator is urging more.

title: Claude Fable 5.5, GPT 6.2 Astra Could Be Right Around the Corner, Leaks Suggest
description: Users say Claude is routing some requests to a stronger unreleased model, a Mythos 5.5 label appeared in Anthropic’s site code, and OpenAI appears to be testing GPT-6.2 Astra.

title: North Korea denies role in $6.3B Binance hack, points finger at US
description: Pyongyang has pushed back against the FBI’s attribution of the Binance attack, with Kim Yo Jong calling the US allegations politically motivated.

title: New Jersey drops Coinbase staking order ahead of crypto’s midterm test
description: New Jersey lifted its staking ban and dropped a $5 million penalty, clearing the way for Coinbase to restore staking access for users in the US state.

title: Bitcoin Firm Strive Climbs Up the Treasury Ranks With Another Big Buy
description: Strive added 124 Bitcoin for about $10 million and now trails Twenty One Capital by 390 BTC for third place among Treasury companies.

title: AI poses greater threat to Bitcoin than quantum computing, Swan founder says
description: The Swan Bitcoin founder warned that hackers are using large language models to exploit security flaws with just a few prompts.

title: Big crypto wants the one thing it can’t buy: your vote
description: Our loyalty has been to the technology. This election, the trap is to let the biggest intermediaries claim it for themselves, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

title: Crypto investigators flag suspected $106M theft, $786K Solana bot drain
description: A European entity may have lost $106 million from exchange accounts, while a wallet associated with a Solana arbitrage bot may have lost another $786,000.

title: Mystery $106 Million Crypto Theft Hits EU Entity Days After Binance Hack
description: Onchain investigator ZachXBT says an unidentified EU entity lost more than $106 million from centralized exchange accounts on Sunday,.

title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
description: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.

title: Coinbase hit with 50% price target cut as post-earnings rout deepens
description: Slowing trading activity and fallout from the Binance hack are clouding Coinbase’s revenue prospects, prompting Morgan Stanley to lower its rating on the stock.

title: Tom Lee Calls Bottom on AI Stock Selloff, Citing Tight Supply and Crypto Resilience
description: The Fundstrat strategist says constraints on AI spending have slowed growth without ending the boom, while crypto’s response to the Binance hack suggests sellers may already be exhausted.

title: Bitcoin risks drop below $76K as 7% oil slide fails to spark BTC price rally
description: Bitcoin fell around 1.7% on Monday as stocks pared early gains fueled by hopes of a diplomatic resolution to the US-Iran war.

title: Mercado Bitcoin wallets show post-hack transfers after $46M theft
description: Brazil’s exchange Mercado Bitcoin paused deposits and withdrawals after a security breach, saying customer funds and data were safe.

title: North Korea Is Laundering Binance Hack Loot at One New Wallet Every 25 Seconds
description: $2.85 billion of the $6.43 billion stolen from Binance has been frozen or seized, compared with about 3% in the Bybit hack, as North Korea’s automated laundering spans 12,000 wallets.

title: Proton Users Revolt After CEO Calls Security Caution 'Loser Thinking' Amid AI Push
description: Proton customers say they are canceling subscriptions after reports of pressure to adopt AI coding, as the privacy company scraps employee re-interviews but defends its broader shift toward automated development.

title: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze
description: Bulls are watching short positions, exchange withdrawals and key price levels for signs of a rebound after the midterms.

title: Animoca Brands clears final hurdle for Abu Dhabi fund management
description: The former mobile games company is building out its fund management business in Abu Dhabi as it targets institutional demand for stablecoins and tokenized assets.

title: Nvidia and Nike Lead Biggest Wave Yet of Tokenized Stock Objections
description: Nvidia, Costco, Nike and nine other companies objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 50.

title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
description: The unidentified attacker moved funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero, but the victim and affected exchanges remain unknown.

title: Elon Musk Mocks Sam Altman Over Claim Home PCs Are Wasting RAM
description: The OpenAI CEO said it's "quite terrible" for DRAM to sit largely idle in personal computers while AI data centers face a supply crunch.

title: Brazil's Largest Exchange Mercado Bitcoin Halts Withdrawals After $40 Million Hack
description: Brazil's largest crypto exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after a security incident. Tether froze more than 4.5 million USDT tied to the attack.

title: NYSE tokenized stock plans take shape as four more transfer agents join
description: Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate join the exchange's planned blockchain market, bringing shareholder records and voting services onchain.

title: Bitmine Buys More Ethereum as Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish
description: The chairman laid out six reasons the market’s “muted” 4% ETH drop after the record Binance theft shows crypto is “increasingly resilient,” as the firm’s stash neared its 5% supply goal.

title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains
description: The Brazilian exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after wallets on at least 10 chains were emptied, days after the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

title: Nvidia, Costco and Nike join pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
description: Nearly 70% of the companies initially picked for trading have opted out, while 19 firms including Apple, Tesla and Amazon have no disclosed objection as the 30-day response window nears its end.

title: Anthropic swings to third quarter operating loss as compute costs surge ahead of IPO
description: The Claude developer generated $17 billion in quarterly revenue, but higher computing costs resulted in a $567 million operating loss.

title: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
description: The bank uses Hong Kong's EnsembleTX system to move deposits between participating banks around the clock, settling in central bank money.

title: How T7X Is Building the Infrastructure for a New Era of Capital Markets
description: T7X records ownership directly on-chain instead of wrapping assets held elsewhere, keeping token and asset under one legal framework.

title: Crypto's Washington playbook is working. Don't abandon it now.
description: Regardless of how the midterm elections unfold or which party secures the presidency in 2028, our industry must adhere to its established playbook, writes Solana Policy Institute’s Colin McLaren.

title: Coinbase downgraded at Morgan Stanley; price target slashed 53% on weak earnings outlook
description: Analyst Michael Cyprys cited weak crypto trading activity and doubts about an earnings recovery.

title: Tokenization firm tZERO plans to go public in $350 million SPAC deal
description: The digital securities firm plans to list on NYSE American under TZRO early next year after more than a decade building blockchain-based trading infrastructure.

title: Strategy spends triple its weekly Bitcoin outlay on STRC buybacks
description: Strategy spent $208.2 million buying back STRC preferred shares and $65.5 million on Bitcoin, while allocating $98.5 million to its USD Cash balance.

title: Morning Minute: Binance Hack Leads to Mass Outflows While FBI Opens Probe
description: Uptober was far from it, with the Binance hack punctuating a red month. Will November be better? Or will the Binance hack hang over crypto?

title: AI agent disputes head to ‘Internet Court’ — and a jury of AI agents
description: Who better to judge a dispute between AI agents than a jury of different AI models? That’s the idea behind GenLayer, which is already issuing thousands of judgements each day.

title: Binance taps half its SAFU Bitcoin holdings, releases reserve proof
description: Binance’s SAFU Bitcoin wallet now holds about 7,500 BTC after a 7,499 BTC transfer linked to the hack, with no timeline for restoring the $1 billion fund.

title: Strategy Resumes Bitcoin Buys With $66M Purchase
description: The Bitcoin treasury firm also spent $208.2 million buying back its STRC preferred stock, cutting its USD Cash balance to $132.7 million.

title: FATF targets crypto hubs in review of money laundering controls
description: The watchdog has not named the jurisdictions under review. Initial findings on compliance with its crypto standards are due in June 2027.

title: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis
description: Crypto exchange Gate said it froze two linked accounts as US investigators urged platforms to block transactions tied to the $6.3 billion theft.

title: XRP Ledger set to fix flaw that could have let stablecoin partners print new tokens
description: The fix is on track for Wednesday after validator support briefly dipped and restarted the two-week activation clock. XRP itself is unaffected.

title: Bitcoin's 'volatility curve' has a midterm bump
description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 2, 2026

title: BTCPay Tells Merchants to Switch Off Servers Amid Hot Wallet Attack Reports
description: The Bitcoin payment software says attacks targeted versions 2.4.1 and older, days after it shipped an emergency fix for a critical flaw.

title: No proof of AI in North Korean hackers move of stolen Binance funds
description: Elliptic tracked thousands of transfers, failed swaps and repeated transactions that suggest the hackers relied on scripts rather than AI agents.

title: Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
description: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $77,900 since midnight UTC as Binance customers pulled a net $3.64 billion after withdrawals reopened and ETFs lost $643 million.

title: From Uptober to Hacktober: Are Bitcoin’s seasonal patterns becoming obsolete?
description: Bitcoin lost 7.3% in October 2026 after another decline the previous year, despite the month’s historically strong returns, as analysts reassess seasonal signals.

title: Trezor lifts password ceiling after Coldcard’s $100M wallet thefts
description: Trezor cited July’s Coldcard attacks, in which strong passphrases helped protect some users whose wallet recovery information was compromised.

title: FBI Blames North Korea for $6B Binance Hack as Exchange Reopens Withdrawals
description: Binance saw $3.64 billion in net outflows in the first nine and a half hours after reopening withdrawals, or 2.1% of its assets, it said.

title: Hong Kong takes tokenized settlement to 24/7, plans stablecoin trials
description: The HKMA plans to bring regulated stablecoins into tokenized government debt trials, while HSBC says its RedCoin stablecoin has reached 50,000 users.

title: BTC heads into US midterm showdown: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
description: Bitcoin price action held its 100-day moving average into the monthly close as crypto markets braced for US midterm election and tech earnings volatility.

title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
description: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.

title: Binance hack fallout, U.S. midterms and jobs report: Crypto Week Ahead
description: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 2.

title: OKX draws $445M in net inflows as Binance outflows exceed $7B
description: OKX led cryptocurrency exchanges with $445 million in daily inflows, while Binance processed about $7 billion in net outflows.
